newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq hits new record in post-holiday quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq hits new record in post-holiday quiet trade.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite index hit a second straight high in otherwise quiet post-holiday trading.

The Nasdaq Composite unofficially closed at 1292.61, up 5.29 points. The previous record close was 1287.32 on Wednesday. The Nasdaq finish on Friday was the fifth consecutive record high for the index.
Winners beat losers by a margin of about four to three, with volume at a light 211 million shares.
U.S. Robotics was among the most active, rising 5-1/8 to 78-5/8. The computer modem maker said Dell Computer would use its latest modem technology in Dell products early next year.
Many traders stayed at home for the day after the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday.
